english.note: Use 襟章 for a physical badge or pin worn on a uniform or item of clothing.
Use this specifically for a badge-style button pinned to clothing.

examples.english: The company requires me to wear a badge at work.
examples.traditional: 公司要求我返工一定要戴襟章。

examples.english: They pinned a button badge to their school uniform.
